settings.heading: Chosen to age well
settings.body: Premium leather with a matte finish that softens with wear — not scuffing, but settling in. Structured to hold its shape and quietly refine over years.

settings.heading: Made in small runs
settings.body: Every piece is stitched, edge-painted and finished by hand in small runs. That means small variations — the hallmark of something made, not manufactured.

settings.short_description: Made from premium leather with matte hardware. Structured to hold its shape and quietly refine with wear.
